`desktop/setup-launcher.cjs` dispatches native Terminal/Linux fallbacks/Windows MozillaBuild. Reject Windows batch-expansion or shell-metacharacter paths. Focused coverage was 21 passing tests; separate-profile Mac launch and packaged first-run startup passed. [Task 2]
